We know that in Wisconsin, dairy is a major part of our agriculture sector. But that dairy farmers have faced significant headwinds, both man-made as well as mother nature, whether that's extreme weather and flooding or whether that's trade issues like we were just discussing, whether that sharp increases in inputs or getting on the other end just a low price for the milk produced. We've seen a lot of small, medium-sized dairy farms go under. That's a result of these significant challenges. So I was so proud to champion the Dairy Business Innovation Initiative in the last Farm Bill. And as a member of the Senate Appropriations Committee, I've been a champion for fully funding it, allowing both producers and processors to add value or create new efficiencies on the farm.
